nom: Origins Checks and Balances Daily Exfoliating Toner

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers largely report no irritation and a gentle, calming feel, though one found the exfoliation too aggressive for sensitive skin when used daily and limited use to three times a week.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the toner balances the T-zone, keeping oil in check while cheeks stay hydrated, without a tight or stripped feeling.
segments.dry: Dry or dry-combination skin reviewers describe the toner as hydrating rather than drying, though one noted it left skin feeling a little dry.
segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report reduced oiliness and a more balanced, matte feel over the day, with pores appearing more refined.

concerns.aging: One reviewer noted a healthier glow and hydrated, glowing look after use, but no reviewer specifically framed the product around anti-aging results.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers found the toner hydrating and non-drying, describing skin as soft, smooth, and comfortable; one dissenting reviewer noted it left skin feeling a little dry.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with a focus on redness reported the witch hazel content seemed to improve redness alongside a tighter, brighter look.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers concerned about irritation or stripping generally report no irritation, dryness, or discomfort, describing the formula as gentle even with daily or twice-daily use.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report a reduction in whiteheads and congestion, with one noting whiteheads visibly reduced after the first use and another noting improved congestion within days.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who struggle with acne report visible clearing and fewer pimples over about a week of daily use, describing skin as less 'pimply'; no reviewer reported new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oily or combination skin report the toner reduces excess oil and keeps the T-zone matte longer, describing skin as balanced and clean rather than oily.

extraits.texte: I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. I found this product to be helpful in helping to clear my acne, prone skin, but a little too aggressive for my sensitive skin. I used it max 3x a week and found it worked the best there. Overall I would recommend to people who have tougher skin than i do.

I've been using this Origins toner for about a week and I'm really impressed with how my skin has been looking and feeling. My skin feels smoother and more refreshed, and I've noticed that it doesn't get as oily throughout the day. My pores also appear more refined, and even some of the small whiteheads and congestion I had seemed to improve pretty quickly. I like that the formula contains AHA, BHA, and Witch Hazel to gently exfoliate and help remove excess oil, dead skin, and impurities that may be left behind after cleansing. It leaves my skin feeling very clean and clarified without feeling overly harsh. I also really enjoy the fresh scent. With continued use, my skin looks clearer, smoother, and more balanced. I would definitely consider purchasing the full size bottle once I finish this one I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes

I used the Origins Checks & Balances Daily Toner mostly in the evening after cleansing, though occasionally in the morning as well. The texture felt very lightweight and refreshing on my skin, absorbing quickly without leaving any sticky or tight feeling. It gave a clean, balanced sensation, especially after a long day. On my combination skin, it helped reduce excess oil in the T-zone while keeping the drier areas comfortable. The scent is subtle and pleasant, with a natural, slightly herbal note that doesn't feel overpowering. Overall, it felt gentle yet effective, making it a nice addition to my daily skincare routine.

This product is so so so good! I have been using it for about a week, and I have noticed my skin looks smoother, less pimply, less oily, and more pore-refined. Even after the first use, my whiteheads on the side of my face went down; it was amazing!! I love the smell and trust this product totally on my sensitive skin. Once my little sample size runs out, I am definitely buying the full bottle; I love it that much! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I finally tried the Origins Checks and Balances Toner and it's a total win for my combination skin. It actually balances everything out without that annoying tight, stripped feeling some toners give. My T-zone stays matte much longer, but my cheeks still feel hydrated. It has a super refreshing, clean scent too. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I have very sensitive combination skin, and using this twice a day feels incredibly gentle. The fresh, pleasant scent makes it enjoyable to use. It leaves my skin super smooth, perfect for applying makeup in the morning, and removes all impurities thoroughly at night, keeping my skin healthy and clean. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from origins for testing and review purposes. I used this toner everyday for a week morning and night. I struggle with acne and I will say that I have seen a difference in my skin clearing up. The toner has a nice earthy scent to it which is very appealing. I will be buying this in the largest size they offer!
